name: session_analyze
description: Get a structural overview of a session. Returns counts of messages and tool calls, a list of every tool used with its frequency, error/failure stats (failed_tool_calls, interrupted_tool_calls, tools_failed, error_step_indices), and an ordered chain of every step in the session (each user message, assistant text, reasoning block, and tool call as its own step, with tool_status). Use this FIRST when investigating or evaluating a session — it gives you the index/reference of every step plus a complete picture of where things went wrong, so you can then call session_get with precise filters (step indices, tool names, or call IDs) to fetch only the content you actually need. No text content is returned here, only structure.

session_id.description: ID of the session to analyze
